title: Derived images and the augmentation spectral sequence on simplicial etale topoi
statement:
Let $a:U_\bullet\to X$ be any augmented simplicial scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For any commutative ring $\Lambda$, its total etale topos has module sheaves given by families $F_p$ of constant-$\Lambda$-module sheaves on $U_{p,\mathrm{Et}}$ and compatible transition maps $u_\alpha^{-1}F_p\to F_q$ for every simplicial map $u_\alpha:U_q\to U_p$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use the derived categories of [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Restriction to a component is exact. For a morphism $h:V_\bullet\to U_\bullet$ of simplicial schemes and any bounded-below complex $L$ on $V_\bullet$, restriction of $Rh_{\bullet,*}L$ to $U_p$ is canonically $Rh_{p,*}L_p$. Derived direct images of these morphisms and augmentations are exact functors of triangulated categories, with the canonical composition isomorphisms normalized by the composite inverse-image adjunction; these identifications are natural for maps of augmented diagrams and their units and counits.

For $L\in D^+(U_\bullet,\Lambda)$ with $H^q(L)=0$ for $q<c$, there is a functorial spectral sequence [def-sp-spectral-sequence]
$$E_1^{p,q}=H^q(Ra_{p,*}L_p)\ \Longrightarrow\ H^{p+q}(Ra_*L),\qquad p\ge0,\ q\ge c.$$
Its first differential is the alternating sum of the face maps. It is computed by the alternating-face double complex of a bounded-below injective resolution on the total topos; the total differential is $d_{\mathrm{face}}+(-1)^p d_{\mathrm{resolution}}$. Its abutment has a decreasing finite filtration with $F^0H^n=H^n$, $F^{\max(n-c+1,0)}H^n=0$, and associated graded objects $E_\infty^{p,n-p}$. Thus the filtration is finite separately in every total degree, without any uniform upper cohomological bound.
